display_title: HORIZON-CL4-2027-01-MAT-PROD-61 Fast Track to Research and Innovation for breakthroughs in industrial technologies (Research and Innovation Action) – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL4-2027-01-MAT-PROD-61 Fast Track to Research and Innovation for breakthroughs in industrial technologies (Research and Innovation Action)
executive_summary: Horizon Europe Research and Innovation Action under Cluster 4 (Digital, Industry and Space) and a Fast Track to Research and Innovation procedure: an open topic for breakthrough innovations in industrial technologies up to TRL 4, within the research agendas of the Made in Europe, Processes4Planet, Clean Steel, Innovative Advanced Materials for the EU and Textiles for the Future partnerships. Consortia may include at most six independent eligible entities and otherwise follow the standard Horizon Europe eligibility rules. Grant at 100% of eligible costs, up to EUR 2.5 million per project, from a topic budget of EUR 20 million for about eight projects, with evaluation results within 4 months and grant signature within 6 months of the deadline. Opened 13 October 2026; single-stage deadline 2 February 2027, 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026–2027 Part 7 (Digital, Industry and Space), pp. 74–75 (HORIZON-CL4-2027-01-MAT-PROD-61, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope), funds early-stage breakthrough research up to TRL 4 in industrial technologies within the research agendas of manufacturing, process-industry, steel, advanced-materials and textiles partnerships. It does not touch TenneT's field: the topic text names no energy, grid or electrification subject, no project file is close, and any link through the partnerships' research agendas would rest on documents the topic only refers to, not on the call itself.
